hypotheses.rationale: The WebSurfer was instructed to scan the video for timestamps of bird species, but instead executed a scroll action that resulted in displaying the YouTube comments section and sidebar recommendations. It failed to access the actual video player or perform any visual analysis of the video content as required by its role, leading to an incorrect conclusion based on non-video text.

The step claims to have performed a scroll action, which did happen technically, but this action moved the agent further away from the goal of analyzing video content, leading to the failure mode suspected.
